verdict.rationale: Claude ships an official desktop app (Mac/Windows/Linux via apt) and, through Cowork's 'computer use' feature, can navigate the user's screen—clicking, typing, opening apps—giving real screen-level access. However, there is no documentation of OS-level keyboard shortcuts or system-wide hotkeys for invoking Claude Desktop, and the screen-control capability appears scoped to the Cowork agentic mode rather than a general screen-reading feature of the desktop app itself. Missing for 10: explicit OS-level shortcut/hotkey documentation, general (non-Cowork) screen/context capture, and independent hands-on confirmation of these desktop behaviors.
